name: influencer.profile_file
description: A new file for the profile picture of a saved collaborator's Instagram account (influencer.picture_due names it by company and handle): our copy of the picture Meta serves. Answers a signed write URL and the file's stable address, which influencer.profile_set then takes. Internal.
sql:
insert into brandbase.account_profiles (org_id, handle, picture_key) values (:org, :handle, :file)
on conflict (org_id, handle) do update set picture_key = excluded.picture_key
returning jsonb_build_object('upload', jsonb_build_object('key', picture_key, 'type', :mime::text)) as result
